CustomField.description: The date/time that an attachment in this specific Yesware sent email was first opened. Only counts opens for Yesware tracked attachments.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Yesware will automatically update this field the first time an attachment is opened in the Yesware sent email represented by this Task. This field captures the date/time of the first attachment open, only for Yesware tracked attachments.
CustomField.label: Yesware First Attachment Open At
